title: thunderbolt loads early
detail: /etc/mkinitcpio.conf.d/thunderbolt_module.conf

title: eGPU driver loads at boot
detail: /usr/lib/modules-load.d/nvidia-580xx-utils.conf loads nvidia-uvm at boot; /etc/modules-load.d/nvidia-580xx-utils.conf does not mask it. Stale mask that masks nothing: /etc/modules-load.d/nvidia-utils.conf. Loading the driver with no card present is the condition that froze this setup before.

title: mkinitcpio does not add the eGPU driver
eGPU driver in the initramfs
detail: lsinitcpio is not installed. Do not rebuild the initramfs with the eGPU attached.

title: NVIDIA module options
detail: nvidia-drm modeset=1 is set (/etc/modprobe.d/nvidia.conf). nvidia options: NVreg_EnableGpuFirmware=0 NVreg_DynamicPowerManagement=0x00 NVreg_PreserveVideoMemoryAllocations=1 NVreg_TemporaryFilePath=/var/tmp.

title: nouveau is blacklisted
detail: /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-nouveau.conf

title: KMS (modeset): unknown
detail: The live parameter is readable by root only. The modprobe options above say what was asked for.

title: fbdev: unknown
detail: The live parameter is readable by root only.

title: NVIDIA closed kernel modules 580.178.04
detail: Omarchy would pick nvidia-open-dkms for this GPU; closed 580xx avoids the GSP hangs seen with it.

title: NVIDIA sleep units: nvidia-suspend nvidia-resume
detail: They do nothing while the driver is unloaded. With the eGPU attached, VRAM is saved to disk on suspend; eject first if you will unplug it while asleep.

title: GPU links are not installed
detail: /dev/dri/omarchy-egpu-primary and -external pin the GPU order without cardN numbers (primary is pci-0000:00:02.0-card). They come with the udev rule.

title: GPU order not pinned
detail: Hyprland chose /dev/dri/card0 (pci-0000:00:02.0-card) by itself. That is right now, but nothing keeps an eGPU attached at login from being picked. AQ_DRM_DEVICES is not set.

fix.label: Write the GPU order, then log out

title: The toggle file is missing
detail: /tmp/omarchy-egpu-fixtures.5smozp/this-machine/home/.local/state/omarchy/toggles/hypr/zz-omarchy-egpu.lua keeps the session's GL, EGL and video decode on the Intel GPU while the eGPU is attached (policy egpu-hdmi).

fix.label: Write the toggle file (omarchy-egpu display apply)

title: vulkaninfo is not installed
detail: Connect uses it to check that Vulkan sees the eGPU; without it that check is skipped.

title: The system half is not installed
detail: Connect, eject and rescan need /usr/local/bin/omarchy-egpu-admin and its polkit action.

title: Steam launch options
detail: Steam is not installed.

title: Games set to the eGPU
detail: Steam is not installed.

title: Optional kernel parameters (minisforum-deg2)
detail: Suggested by the Arch wiki External GPU page, not confirmed necessary: pcie_ports=native pci=assign-busses,hpbussize=0x33,realloc,hpmmiosize=128M,hpmmioprefsize=16G. Set now: none.
